verdict.rationale: Asking whether a government tax portal publishes current processing times is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence pack shows only registration and filing help modules, a grievance tracker and a list of upcoming due dates. None of these publishes processing times for a transaction type. Filing deadlines and issue tracking are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
